text: Paysafe Limited (NYSE: PSFE) reports that its principal shareholders - parties to its shareholders agreement, led by funds of CVC (25.4%) and Blackstone (21.4%) - beneficially own approximately 54.4% of its common shares.
short: CVC (25.4%) and Blackstone (21.4%) funds lead Paysafe's principal shareholders, about 54.4% together.

source.name: Paysafe Ltd, Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 (SEC EDGAR, filed 3 March 2026)
source.quote: Our Principal Shareholders beneficially own approximately 54.4% of our Company Common Shares.
source.note: The filing's Item 7.A table (beneficial ownership as of February 20, 2026) shows CVC 12,999,672 shares (25.4%) and Blackstone 10,914,696 (21.4%); the filing defines 'Principal Shareholders' as 'collectively, the Founder, Cannae LLC, the CVC Investors and the Blackstone Investors'. Cannae sold its remaining shares in November 2025 (FNF Holdings 4.4%). No state or state fund appears among the holders.
